title: Filter catalog candidates through existing readiness and label indexes before scanning project history
outcome: Catalog candidate selection restricts lifecycle and label membership through existing indexes before reading candidate rows, so ls and the READY queue do not grow with completed project history.
acceptance: The existing catalog query restricts candidates through work_items_ready or work_item_labels_lookup before candidate-row reads, without adding an index or requiring store repair
A fixed-pending VM-count regression stays flat as completed history grows, including the open-unlabelled control
Existing catalog filtering, ordering and continuation behavior remain unchanged
